verdict.rationale: Aleph documents versioned forecasts with scenario modeling, and separately lists audit logs among its security features. Together these suggest some record of scenario versions and changes, but nothing shows that assumptions are captured per scenario or tied to the user who changed them for an auditable comparison. missing for 10: per-scenario assumption records, change attribution (who changed which assumption), audit-log coverage of scenario edits, scenario comparison audit trail, in-depth docs or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a finance lead, each scenario records its assumptions and who changed them, so a comparison is auditable

citations.quote: Versioned forecasts, scenario modeling, and board-ready variance analysis.
enterprise-grade security featuring access controls, fine-grained permissions, audit logs, and more.
